annotations.title: Get the per-minute price of calls to a number

description: Get the per-minute price of an outgoing call, or of a call forwarded, to one phone number, by the longest matching prefix. The same price applies when a call to a SendMyCall number is forwarded to that phone. The number is used for the lookup only: it is not stored or returned.

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format: + then country code and number, 7 to 15 digits, e.g. +442079460000.

name: get_calling_rate

matched_prefix.description: The longest prefix that matched, without +; null when none matched or the rule is the whole number.

price_per_minute.description: US dollars per minute as a decimal string; null when not offered.

title: Get the per-minute price of calls to a number
